say:1:1430243101:1.text: It was the Queen who brought us down to this underground world to live and pray.
say:1:1430243101:1.source_cn: 是女王带我们来到这片地下，在这里安居乐业。
say:1:1430243101:1.male: It was the Queen who brought us down to this underground world to live and pray.
say:1:1430243101:1.female: It was the Queen who brought us down to this underground world to live and pray.

say:2:1430243102:1.text: It was also Her Majesty who bestowed upon us the Divine Dew, allowing us to rebel against the curse.
say:2:1430243102:1.source_cn: 也是女王赐下灵露，让我们得以对抗诅咒。
say:2:1430243102:1.male: It was also Her Majesty who bestowed upon us the Divine Dew, allowing us to rebel against the curse.
say:2:1430243102:1.female: It was also Her Majesty who bestowed upon us the Divine Dew, allowing us to rebel against the curse.

say:3:1430243103:1.text: The Queen created Sal'thorin, and she will live on as the kingdom lives on forever.
say:3:1430243103:1.source_cn: 女王创造了萨洛克兰，她自将永存于她的国。
say:3:1430243103:1.male: The Queen created Sal'thorin, and she will live on as the kingdom lives on forever.
say:3:1430243103:1.female: The Queen created Sal'thorin, and she will live on as the kingdom lives on forever.
